description: This file defines the LocationDecorator class, which extends functionality for the Location entity by providing methods for setting related country data and retrieving employee counts. It includes dependency injection, service retrieval, and entity manipulation typical of a decorator pattern within a PHP project.

classes.name: LocationDecorator
classes.description: A PHP class implementing a decorator for the Location entity, providing methods to set associated country data and retrieve employee numbers, utilizing service classes and traits for database and service management.

methods.name: setLocationService
methods.description: Sets the LocationService instance for this decorator.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Retrieves the current LocationService instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a Location entity.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the Location entity being decorated.

methods.name: setCountryByCountryCode
methods.description: Associates a country to the location based on the provided country code.

methods.name: getNoOfEmployees
methods.description: Returns the number of employees in the associated location.
